name: Simpla-12
description: Simpla-12 was a neglected, underdeveloped planet, strip-mined and criminal-infested. Jenna Zan Arbor had a lab on the planet surface, and performed her twisted experiments on unfortunate Jedi there. The thieves Cholly, Weez, and Tup lived there, as well as the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.
lead_paragraphs: Simpla-12 was a neglected, underdeveloped planet, strip-mined and criminal-infested. The thieves Cholly, Weez, and Tup lived there, as well as the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.
